definitions.explanation: An affirmative response indicating agreement or acknowledgment.
A response when one's name is called, indicating presence.
Used to signal that one has heard and understood, or to get attention.

examples.japanese: 「⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{要|い}りますか→要る：09589_iru⟧。」「はい、⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。」
{回答者|かいとうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧80%⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「はい」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
はい、⟦{分|わ}かりました→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
はい、⟦{皆|みな}さん→皆さん：02971_minasan⟧、⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}して→注目する：25530_chuumokusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
はい is the standard affirmative response in Japanese.

USAGE:
- As "yes": Affirms a statement or question
- As "here": Response when name is called (roll call, etc.)
- As attention-getter: Similar to "okay" or "all right"

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- はい does NOT mean the speaker agrees with an opinion—it indicates the speaker heard and understood
- In response to negative questions, はい confirms the negative (opposite of English)
  - 「⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？」「はい。」 = "You're not going?" "That's right (I'm not going)."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- はい - formal/standard "yes"
- ⟦ええ→ええ：02893_ee⟧ - softer, slightly casual "yes"
- うん - casual/informal "yeah"

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- はい、そうです (Yes, that's right)
- はい、⟦{分|わ}かりました→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (Yes, I understand)
- はい、⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧ (Yes, please go ahead / Here you are)
